patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; Zenzap is narrower/specialist.

Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; Zenzap is narrower/specialist. Choose Nextiva only if your buying job matches “SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/mo” rather than Zenzap's shape. Choose Zenzap only if your buying job matches “Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — ” rather than Nextiva's shape. Workflow advantage: Nextiva leans business-phone, customer-messaging; Zenzap leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; Zenzap is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Nextiva is SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/month annual, with messaging apps including WhatsApp; Zenzap is Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — free tier, Pro $3/user/month yearly, Business+ $8 .
- Workflow coverage skew: Nextiva-leaning business-phone, customer-messaging, contact-center vs Zenzap-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Nextiva — Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Zenzap — Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+.

Limitations — Nextiva: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Analytics and AI assistance require Scale / higher plans or XBert add-on from $99/mo; Zenzap: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+.

Poor-fit cases: Nextiva is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included · Zenzap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+ · Avoid Nextiva if you actually need Zenzap's motion (Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
